notes:
2026-09-16 (card-results AI-fact-elimination sweep, fin/31): re-examined the 3 remaining unprovenanced facts fact-by-fact (front face's onUpkeep `kind:'custom'` effect: Library->Hand tutor source, Food-token entersBattlefield source, Library sink). `apply-recognizers.mjs`/`verify-synergy.mjs`: 0 hard failures, unchanged, 0 new facts closed. Confirmed none of the 3 can migrate off `kind:'custom'` today, for two STACKED reasons (not just the one already on file): (1) `card.ts`'s own `kind:'dig'` Effect (the natural declarative shape for a library-peek-and-take) has `validType?: 'artifact' | 'any'` only — no creature-OR-artifact union — and `digReveal-effect-structural.ts` itself already declines every real pool card using `validType:'any'` as an approximation of a narrower multi-type disjunction (Commune with Beavers, Esper Origins), so even `'any'` wouldn't be textually honest here; this card's own real text needs a genuine `hasAny:['Artifact','Creature']`-style union `dig` doesn't have. (2) Independently checked whether the whole effect could instead move onto the combinator DSL (`kind:'program'`) per this project's own 'combinator DSL is default over custom' standing rule — it can't: `combinator.ts`'s own `Query`/`Sequence`/`Each`/`SelectUpTo` vocabulary has NO library-zone source at all (`creaturesInPlay`/`permanentsInPlay` are the only two `Query.source` values that exist; nothing reads 'top card of library'), so there's no way to even START expressing 'look at the top library card' in that DSL today, let alone the conditional reveal+token-creation+transform bundle that follows it. Both are real engine-core vocabulary gaps (a `dig`-validType widening AND/OR a combinator library-peek primitive), not recognizer-lane gaps and not something closable via a definition.ts restructuring alone — escalating to engine-core (via the orchestrator) rather than attempting a half-migration that would either misrepresent the card's real text (an over-broad `validType:'any'`) or simply not compile (no library Query source to build from). Genuinely still blocked, re-confirmed rather than re-asserted from the prior note.

2026-09-16 (fin/26-50 re-triage): re-verified fresh, 0 hard failures. 3 AI facts remain, all part of the front face's single kind:'custom' upkeep effect — already documented as bespoke in definition.ts's own comment (`dig`'s `validType` only covers 'artifact'|'any', never a creature-OR-artifact union — same class as Commune with Beavers' documented decline in digReveal-effect-structural.ts's own module comment). No new gap; flagged to the orchestrator as a possible future `dig`/recognizer widening (a `hasAny` type-list on `validType`) that would also help phoenix-down's own mode-1 exile filter.

Back face (Land, Cooking Campsite): addMana (colors:{has:['W']}, exempted from trace evidence — plain single-color static text), self-tap cost, a real 'sacrifice a DIFFERENT permanent as cost' SOURCE fact (event:'sacrifice', target:{types:{has:['Artifact']}}) — first pool card of this exact shape besides The Gold Saucer — plus putCounterAll's own putCounter fact and two sinks (wants an Artifact to sacrifice, wants Creatures to benefit). Confirmed via real oracle text (Scryfall fin/31) that this card's own 'transform this enchantment' is a genuine CR 712.6 in-place flip, NOT Dion/Jill/Jecht's own literal 'exile, then return' mechanic — correctly modeled as text-only (no zone facts for the transform itself), unlike those three cards. Real find-synergies.mjs diff (isolated to just this card's own 4 changed files, git-checked-out HEAD before/after, full pool both times): 0 regressions; 2 old bare-presence-shaped source facts correctly relabeled from 'battlefield presence'/'hand presence' to real 'enters the battlefield'/'tutor' zone-movement names (same real matches preserved, not new); the front face's self-enters + Food-token-enters facts now both independently (and correctly, non-lossily) satisfy the same 12 real unconstrained ETB sinks (expected duplicate, same class already documented for summon-bahamut's own merge); +17 genuinely new matches from the new back-face 'wants an Artifact on the battlefield' sink against real Artifact-producing cards pool-wide (Cargo Ship, Crystal Fragments x2, Diamond Weapon, Dragoon's Lance, Iron Giant, Lunatic Pandora, Machinist's Arsenal, Magitek Armor, Magitek Infantry x2, Omega Heartless Evolution, Paladin's Arms, Phoenix Down, Ring of the Lucii, Scorpion Sentinel, The Regalia). vitest run functional-model: 238/238 pass.
